items.fit: Developers with Hedera and smart-contract experience; or community professionals in marketing, education, UX/UI or project management.
items.work: Run technical workshops, make technical content, support developers, organize events, build partnerships or make community content.
items.reward: Certificates, swag and badges. Cash or token amount not stated.
items.safety: Open the linked form from Hedera’s official page. No crypto payment request was found on the page.

items.fit: People aged 18+ interested in blockchain education, security and community building. Prior experience is suggested, not required.
items.work: Host events, share educational content, support newcomers and connect academic communities.
items.reward: Mentorship, experience, recognition, resources and merchandise. Cash pay not stated.
items.selection: Application; the site says review and reply in 5–7 business days, with a possible interview.
items.safety: Use the Typeform only from Cyfrin’s official page. SSCD+ certification is required within six weeks after onboarding to continue.

items.fit: Community contributors. Soneium encourages past and current Soneian Community Program participants and highlights the US, Japan, Korea and China.
items.work: Onboard users, answer community questions, host meetups, guide people through apps and support builders.
items.reward: Recognition, team resources, support for approved activations, events and content, and merch or community rewards when available. Cash or token amount not stated.
items.selection: The issuer says it reviews background, Soneium history, community experience, location, availability and fit; a short follow-up may be requested.
items.safety: The official page explicitly says Apply now and links a Typeform. The hosted page did not expose its questions or a submission-state message. Do not assume selection or payment.

items.fit: Community builders, active Aster users or traders, and people with a track record of community work.
items.work: Host meetups, workshops, AMAs or trading sessions; onboard users; give product feedback.
items.reward: Event support up to $5,000 per event, toolkit, merchandise, promotion and early product access. Aster says there is no direct salary.
items.selection: Application; Aster says it reviews applicants within two weeks and may invite qualified candidates to a screening call.
items.safety: The issuer page did not render its announcement text in this check. The row remains based on the 14 Sep issuer check; the role can involve futures, perpetuals and high-leverage trading education.

items.fit: People with strong interpersonal and communication skills; some roles expect knowledge of Elk products.
items.work: Community work, content, events, partnerships, translation, design or development.
items.reward: The selected apprentice works as a volunteer during the trial. Post-trial benefits and their value are not stated.
items.selection: Application, then an interview subject to qualification, then a trial period.
items.safety: The official page links a hosted application. Do not assume post-trial benefits are paid compensation.

items.fit: Creators and community contributors willing to make content, engage users and organize promotion.
items.work: Make posts, videos or articles; join discussions; help with events and campaigns; promote referrals.
items.reward: 30% of minting fees from referrals and 30% off Score minting. The unit, payout timing and other conditions are not stated.
items.selection: Sign-up form; review process is not stated.
items.safety: This is a contributor role with referral-linked rewards, not a stated wage or stipend.

items.fit: People aged 18+ with an active public Telegram, X, Instagram or YouTube channel. The issuer says no follower minimum applies.
items.work: Create public content, join community conversations and complete a seven-day initiation track with a reviewed proof pack.
items.deadline: Applications open. No closing deadline published; the issuer calls the founding cohort limited.
items.reward: USDT rewards of $100 at 50K verified views, $150 at 100K and $250 at 200K per post; monthly TOR exchanges and shared USDT pools. All rewards depend on review.
items.selection: Manual review. The terms require a Torium account in good standing and accurate social-account information; approved candidates complete the seven-day track.
items.safety: No independent payout report was checked. USDT payouts are described as BSC wallet payments after approval; read the privacy, reward and disclosure terms before joining.

items.fit: Senior contributors with local crypto and marketing connections, B2B sales experience, strong networking and public-speaking skills.
items.work: Build local partnerships and community, make content, represent Nexo at events, support affiliate growth, engage local media and localize content.
items.reward: Nexo says “competitive salary” and result-based incentives. It does not state an amount, targets, payment schedule or jurisdiction limits.
items.selection: The official page shows a contact form. Its review process and response time are not stated.
items.safety: On 16 Sep, the tracked official page displayed name, email, phone, LinkedIn and contribution fields after it did not render a route on 15 Sep. Re-open the official page and read the privacy terms before submitting.

items.fit: Global community builders who can lead meetups, create content or represent Oasis. Other eligibility rules are not stated on the current hub.
items.work: Lead meetups, create content and represent Oasis globally.
items.reward: Exclusive bounties, professional mentorship and early ecosystem access. Cash or token amount not stated.
items.selection: The official community hub links a “Become a Sentinel” form; review and response terms are not stated on the hub.
items.safety: The issuer-linked route is a Google Form. Inspect its fields before sharing contact, social or wallet information.

items.fit: People already active in crypto, Web3, fintech or adjacent communities, especially in active local hubs. The job post names Argentina and Latin America, Southeast and East Asia, and Eastern Europe as interests, while saying applications are global.
items.work: Introduce and educate users; build local relationships; represent Fiber at meetups; create local content; gather feedback; explore growth ideas.
items.reward: Monthly compensation and possible performance-based revenue share. Amount and individual terms are discussed only with selected candidates.
items.selection: The company-linked job post asks applicants to describe their community and contribution plan and to email a résumé or CV. It says there are no fixed hours or exclusivity requirements.
items.safety: Fiber’s official company post links the third-party job post. Verify the link from Fiber’s official profile before emailing a CV or creating an account for the optional fibertag reference.

items.fit: People with 500+ social followers or a 100+ member community, plus substantial trading experience.
items.work: Bring people to Bitget and promote spot, futures, CFDs, RWAs and trading promotions; share trading strategies.
items.reward: Access to a $50,000 promotion pool, support fund, rebates up to 50% and bonus credits. Individual award amounts are not stated.
items.selection: Bitget says applications are reviewed within seven working days; existing affiliates and direct referrals are ineligible.
items.safety: This is a trading-community growth campaign, not a general contributor role. Verify any Telegram contact is an official Bitget account.

items.fit: Experienced community members who can organize local meetups, make educational content, help people onboard safely, or connect a local community.
items.work: Organize Community Builder Nights, make educational content, help with safe Web3 onboarding, and act as a local connector.
items.deadline: Last explicit public form status: closed on 4 Jun 2026. No later reopening notice was found in the official forum pages inspected on 14 Sep.
items.reward: Participation is voluntary and unpaid. MetaMask says basic resources and support may depend on how you contribute.
items.selection: An earlier forum post describes rolling review, but staff replies say the form was closed. A current public submission route is not confirmed.
items.safety: Use only the official MetaMask Builder Hub. Do not treat an old application reference or a direct message as a current route.
items.status_label: Not confirmed: public form last reported closed

items.fit: 18+ undergraduates graduating after Dec 2026, available 4–6 hours weekly, and not formal ambassadors for a competing chain or company.
items.work: Four workshops per semester, weekly build nights and a demo day.
items.reward: USDC semester stipend in milestone-based installments; amount not stated.
items.selection: Two 60-second videos and short answers. The page says it reviews every application.
items.safety: The issuer still shows fields, but its published 1 Sep deadline has passed. Do not submit without a new official reopening notice.

items.fit: Contributors with content, outreach, events or community skills who have a referral.
items.work: Advocacy, content, outreach, events, mentoring and local or global initiatives.
items.reward: Not stated on the inspected program page.
items.selection: The official page says positions are referrals only and asks applicants to name their referrer.
items.people: A May 2026 forum reply from a program representative said there were 13 funded contributors and three mentors unpaid. It is a program response, not pay proof.
items.safety: This is not general open access. Confirm the referrer rule before submitting.

items.fit: For a future reopening; applications are closed now.
items.work: Social conversation, content, feedback and community activity.
items.reward: The page describes a $200 monthly crypto base reward, with $10 or $15 X-impression rewards subject to review; not available to new applicants now.
items.selection: Not applicable while applications are closed.
items.safety: Follow the official account only for a reopening. Do not treat listed reward terms as a current offer.

items.fit: Current university or college students in Ghana, South Africa, Kenya, Uganda, Ethiopia or Nigeria. Interest in crypto, blockchain, fintech or digital finance; active in student communities or social media.
items.work: Build a local campus community, support peers with digital-finance education, organize meetups or workshops, and share Bybit learning resources and product updates.
items.deadline: No closing deadline published. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.
items.reward: Performance-based rewards and bonuses, merchandise, and campaign, airdrop or promotion access. Amount and conditions are not stated.
items.selection: Issuer-linked application form; shortlisted students are contacted for onboarding. Detailed selection criteria and response time are not stated.
items.safety: The official page links a hosted Lark form. Inspect its fields before sharing student, contact or social information. This is an exchange-affiliated education and product-promotion role.

items.fit: Global developers, creators, students and professionals. Choose Developer or Community Ambassador work.
items.work: Developer track: build, test and advocate for the tech stack; host hackathons and workshops. Community track: lead meetups, content and collaborations.
items.deadline: No deadline published. Each stated term lasts six months and tracks milestones.
items.reward: Token rewards, NFTs and ecosystem perks. The issuer says this is not a fixed salary; token unit, value and redemption terms are not stated.
items.selection: Form, past-work review, optional interview, onboarding and contract, according to the issuer.
items.safety: The official page shows an application form but its fields were not available in this check. Read fields and contract terms before sharing personal, social or wallet information.

items.fit: Community members active in Pendulum or Amplitude who want to promote its goals. Technical expertise is a plus, not a stated requirement.
items.work: Claim a Discord role, introduce yourself, contribute community content and progress through ranks. Higher ranks may be selected for bounties.
items.reward: The issuer says the position is not paid. It lists networking, merchandise, event invitations and possible bounties.
items.selection: No formal application review is published. The issuer directs people to Discord to claim an ambassador role.
items.safety: This is Discord enrollment, not a published job application. Reach Discord from the issuer page and do not infer cash pay or a guaranteed bounty.

items.fit: The issuer names traders familiar with prediction markets and leverage, plus builders, writers and community contributors.
items.work: The issuer says ambassadors may provide feedback, help shape markets and explain the protocol.
items.deadline: The issuer says applications are open; no deadline published.
items.reward: The published post retains a bracketed reward-structure placeholder. Do not treat rewards as stated.
items.selection: A linked Google Form; review terms are not published.
items.safety: The issuer says the product is on BNB testnet and mainnet awaits a third-party audit. The same post leaves reward and regional-priority placeholders unfinished.
